# one JSON line: cancel two named jobs of this user, then list the user's queue
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function run_out(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * String(take!(err)) : "")
end
user = strip(run_out(`whoami`))
parts = Pair{String,String}[]
push!(parts, "scancel" => run_out(`scancel 2098841 2098842`))
sleep(3)
push!(parts, "squeue_user" => run_out(`squeue -u $user -o "%.10i %.12P %.24j %.2t %.10M %R"`))
push!(parts, "sacct" => run_out(`sacct -j 2098841,2098842,2098965 --format=JobID,State,Elapsed -P`))
println("{" * join(["$(esc(k)):$(esc(v))" for (k, v) in parts], ",") * "}")
